summary: Matriz de capabilities provedor x evento x familia (RF-59, 100 celulas, testdata/hook-capability-matrix.json + docs/hook-capability-matrix.md, artefato separado da matriz existente que permanece intocada). Duas rodadas de revisao (REJECTED por gate wiring ausente -> APPROVED apos ligar capability_instrumentation ao alvo check-hook-capability-matrix-sync, ja conectado ao job integration do CI). make test lint vet check-capability-matrix-sync check-hook-capability-matrix-sync integration coverage verdes.
